evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: Ever dreamed of creating a genre-defining masterpiece? Star of Games is a next-gen simulation management game centered on game dev. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends. FOLLOW US X: @Infini_Fun About the Game Have you ever dreamed of creating a game masterpiece that defines an era, or moves millions of players? Have you ever imagined standing shoulder-to-shoulder with gaming legends, carving your own name into the annals of gaming history? Welcome to Star of Games, a deeply immersive simulation management game centered around game development. Here, you'll step into the shoes of an ambitious game developer, starting from a small garage studio and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating legends, to creating them, and ultimately changing the world. I. Forge Legendary Games: Start from the Genes In Star of Games, creating games is no longer just about combining genres. We introduce the revolutionary "Game Gene System", allowing you to delve deep into the soul of game design. Deconstruct Legends, Extract Genes : Place iconic titles into your "Gene Decoding Lab." Analyze the core of their success—level design, narrative pacing, game mechanics… everything can be extracted and become the foundation of your own creations. Recombine Genes, Create New Classics : Fuse unique gene sequences and integrate your chosen development philosophy—be it a "player-experience-first" craftsman's approach or a "tech-driven innovation" geek route. Every decision you make will shape the soul of your game. Deep Marketing, Ignite the Buzz : Move beyond simple paid promotions. Build your marketing team and strategize a campaign that engages players, media, and influencers. Will you create mystery, showcase boldly, use scarcity tactics, or rely on word-of-mouth? The market is yours to set ablaze. II. Build a Game Empire: Dance with Legends Personal success is just the beginning—building a great company is the real challenge. In the vast world of Star of Games, you are not alone. Encounter Legends, as Rivals or Allies : Well-known companies will be your inspirations, your competitors, and potential partners. Compete with them for Game of the Year, collaborate to gain tech licenses, or even participate in developing their legendary sequels. R ecruit Masters, Nurture New Talent : As you rise to prominence, legendary producers might appear, offering guidance, tasks, or even a chance to recruit them! At the same time, nurture your employees—they have dreams too, and one day, a star from your company might become your strongest rival. Define Your Path, Evolve Your Tech : Our unique tech tree system represents not just technological advancement, but the evolution of your company's strategy, culture, and business model. Will you become an "Artisan Workshop" focused on refined games, or a "Tech Titan" leading industry trends? The future is shaped by every R&D choice you make. III. Transcend Gaming: Become a Cultural Icon When your works become classics and your company is hailed as legendary, your influence will extend far beyond the gaming industry. You will become a cultural symbol defining the next era. Cross-media Expansion, Build an IP Empire : Lead the film and TV adaptation of your legendary titles, collaborating with top directors to create box office hits. License or build physical theme parks based on your game worlds, turning them into pilgrimage sites for fans globally. Elevate Value, Impact Society : Partner with universities and medical institutions to develop serious educational games or therapeutic experiences. Use the power of games to create profound social value and earn respect that goes beyond commerce. Reach the Pinnacle, Achieve Immortality : Establish your own video game museum, found an award named after you, and have your design philosophy written into textbooks. You are no longer just a successful businessperson—you have become a part of gaming culture itself. Game Features Dynamic Story Generator : Every new game is a unique story. The personal dramas of employees, competitors' business secrets, and the birth of legends are all dynamically generated by your choices. Relatability Meets Relaxation : Authentically captures industry challenges like project delays, technical bottlenecks, and team conflicts—enough to make you smile wryly in recognition. The overall lighthearted and humorous tone makes strategizing and decision-making a genuine pleasure. Ultimate Freedom of Exploration : From game concepts to corporate strategy, talent management to business alliances—there is no single formula for success. Every path can lead to your own version of Rome. A Treasure Trove of Easter Eggs : The game is packed with countless Easter eggs referencing gaming history, industry jargon, and classic titles, waiting to be discovered and savored by true core players. evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine. When the old can no longer protect the land, the small must learn to carry the tune. For as long as anyone can remember, a kind witch has cared for the forest and the creatures who call it home. But now, the world is beginning to fall out of harmony—and the witch who has always protected it is growing ill. Her smallest familiars must venture beyond the shelter of home and learn to carry the responsibility that once belonged to her. Though she cannot join them, her magic is never far away—a gentle hand, ready to lift them back to safety. Playing as a brave little mouse, you’ll journey through a vast world shaped by the beauty and wonder of Swedish nature, helping those you meet and restoring harmony one act of kindness at a time. Hela: of Mice & Magic is a heartfelt 3D open-world adventure about care, courage, and discovering how much even the smallest among us can do. Explore alone or share the journey with friends in local split-screen and online co-op. Carry Her Kindness Into the Wild The witch has spent her life caring for the world around her. Now, it is your turn to care for her and to continue the work she can no longer carry alone. Gather ingredients, brew magical potions, solve environmental puzzles, and lend a helping paw to animals and communities throughout the land. Each small act brings you closer to restoring its harmony and helping the witch who has long cared for you and all the forest’s inhabitants. See the World Through Tiny Eyes Travel through a lovingly crafted playground inspired by the landscapes of Northern Sweden, from rugged mountain trails and magical forests to tranquil lakes and misty wetlands. To a mouse, even familiar places become enormous. Everyday objects transform into obstacles, opportunities, and unexpected playgrounds, while hidden paths and story fragments reward those who stop, listen, and look a little closer. Glide through the air, climb to new heights, experiment with the world around you, and find your own way through an adventure filled with quiet wonder. Work together to explore the landscape, overcome challenges, and discover playful solutions. Meet Froggy Your magical Froggy backpack is more than a useful tool, it is your constant companion on the road ahead. Use Froggy to leap, swing, glide, gather resources, interact with the environment, and solve puzzles. As your journey continues, you’ll discover new ways for Froggy to help you reach hidden places and navigate a world built for curiosity. evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: Run an airline the competent way you wish they were like in real life. Open routes, buy aircraft, build the weekly schedule, and hire crew qualified to fly it. No cockpits, no cutscenes. Just the network, the numbers, and fierce rivals aiming to take a cut of your market share. Skylane is an airline tycoon where you never touch the plane's controls. You do the job that actually decides whether an airline lives: which city pairs to serve, how often, with which aircraft, and who is qualified to crew them. Start with one hub and one aircraft. Draw a route, lay flights across the week, hire a captain and a first officer rated on the type, and wait for the first load factor to come back. Then you scale operations, but all while fuel prices move, airframes age, and rival carriers expand into the markets you were saving for later. Every screen is one keystroke away and the clock stops whenever you want it to. The question is never whether you can see the whole airline at once. It is whether you can still explain, after 10 years running your company, why every aircraft is exactly where it is supposed to be. ONE ROUTE IS A DECISION. evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: A tycoon game about building a racing factory from your garage. Scavenge, buy or design your own parts, fix cars, and climb every tier of motorsport. Balancing tight finances and decaying parts forces hard calls: repairs, upgrades, or paying the debts to keep the team alive. WORKS: Motorsport Factory is a top-down tycoon sim about everything that happens before a racing car reaches the circuit. Manage a motorsport team from the ground up: staff, facilities, car design and development while trying to stay competitive on a limited budget. Secure sponsors, hire mechanics, source parts and keep the operation running long enough to make it to race day. Five tiers of motorsport stand between your workshop and the being the most prestigious team in motorsport. Progress is not a straight climb - it’s a long-term struggle of financial pressure, technical setbacks and outperforming better-funded rivals. You manage the operation that makes the racing possible. Build the car. Prepare the spares. Manage the crew. Get the right driver in the seat. Load the truck. Get everything out of the factory and to the circuit before the departure deadline. While you wait at the factory the racing happens, watch the timing screens and wait. When the results come in your work begins again worn parts, crash damage and everything you learned about the car. Your crew goes to work. Deliveries arrive. Builders get back to work on the new section of the garage. Every job takes time. Every job needs someone to do it. Where you put things, who you hire, how your workshop is laid out and what your crew is doing right now all matter. The factory isn't a menu. It's a working place. Each part has a story. Each part has a lifespan. A brand new part at race one is not the same at the end of a season. Performance drops off, wear accumulates and eventually a part will fail. Run it too hard and repair it too much and it won't perform the same again. You can design parts for performance, endurance or reliability but getting the right balance to cover all three can be impossible Every part has a breaking point. Every part has a finite mileage lifespan. Every part has a performance drop-off that only reveals itself under real conditions. The better your facilities and the stronger your technical staff, the more of the truth you can uncover. And in a sport where tenths of a second matter, knowledge is often more valuable than raw performance. Five tiers of racing with many routes to reach the top. Whether it's from Karting to Open Wheel or Banger racing to Touring Cars, you're picking the route. Getting into the next series isn't just about winning. Drivers have careers of their own. Rivals develop. Sponsors can be offended. Contracts have teeth. Regulations change. Last year's dominance can become deemed illegal next season. You might have the fastest car and no money to run it. You might have the best driver and nothing worth putting them in. You might spend an entire season fighting for the last championship point that keeps the team alive. A thousand years ago, a great war between immortals and demons ended in a narrow victory for the immortal realm — but the Gate between realms was shattered. Spiritual energy fell into chaos, and monsters began to roam the world. You stand in humanity’s last sanctuary, built at the only gap in the massive natural barrier known as the Broken Realm Mountains. Outside lies the demon-infested Wildlands of Ten Thousand Monsters. Inside lies the last mortal kingdom. As the senior brother, it is your duty to hold the line and protect the final pure land of humanity. Backpack Like × Strategic Build-Crafting × Bullet-Heaven Shooting Before every wave of demons, you receive a random set of artifacts. Making the best use of limited space is a real test of strategy and decision-making. The game features strong backpack like / backpack management gameplay — the deeper you go, the more satisfying it becomes. Artifact Fusion & Evolution — Build Your Ultimate Strategy Some artifacts can evolve into two different types of super artifacts when fused to max level. Pairing the right sisters with the right artifacts is how you maximize your team’s combat power. management, strategic build-crafting, and bullet-heaven shooting. A thousand years ago, a great war between immortals and demons ended in a narrow victory for the immortal realm — but the Gate between realms was shattered. Spiritual energy fell into chaos, and monsters began to roam the world. You stand in humanity’s last sanctuary, built at the only gap in the massive natural barrier known as the Broken Realm Mountains. Outside lies the demon-infested Wildlands of Ten Thousand Monsters. Inside lies the last mortal kingdom. As the senior brother, it is your duty to hold the line and protect the final pure land of humanity. Backpack Like × Strategic Build-Crafting × Bullet-Heaven Shooting Before every wave of demons, you receive a random set of artifacts. You must place, upgrade, and fuse them within a limited backpack grid to survive wave after wave of attacks. Artifacts come in many types, each with its own focus: Some excel at single-target burst Some excel at AoE damage Some excel at healing and sustain Some excel at crowd control and slow Every artifact takes up a different number of grid slots. Making the best use of limited space is a real test of strategy and decision-making. The game features strong backpack like / backpack management gameplay — the deeper you go, the more satisfying it becomes. Artifact Fusion & Evolution — Build Your Ultimate Strategy Some artifacts can evolve into two different types of super artifacts when fused to max level. Choosing the right evolution path and pairing it with different heroes and artifacts is the key to forming a truly powerful build. Will you go for burst single-target damage, or sustained damage over time? Will you snipe one enemy at a time, or clear the entire screen? Every run offers a different answer. Meet Red-Robed Junior Sisters — Build Your Xianxia Team In this xianxia world, you will encounter many junior sisters. Each one is a powerful support with unique abilities and roles, and each is a key factor in clearing high-difficulty stages. Pairing the right sisters with the right artifacts is how you maximize your team’s combat power. Dao Body Upgrade & Star-Up — Don’t Ignore Early Growth While growing stronger as a senior brother, don’t forget to upgrade your Dao Body. Early Dao Body star-up is very important — do not neglect it. The stronger your Dao Body, the more stable your survival and damage output in battle. Accumulate resources in every run so your artifacts, Dao Body, and junior sisters all grow together, allowing you to challenge even higher-difficulty stages. evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: In the summer of 2032, fourteen-year-old Lin Haoyang receives a box of old photographs sent by his father from Xi'an. Sorting albums, identifying faces, and completing the family tree, he slowly pieces together a century of memories of an ordinary Chinese family over six summer days. 2032. Summer. Fourteen-year-old Lin Haoyang is spending the summer alone in Shanghai. His mother is on a business trip in Japan; his father has gone back to the family home to arrange his great-grandmother's funeral. Then a box arrives from home: an empty album, a document bag, and a bundle of old black-and-white photographs. "You've got nothing better to do this summer. Sort these into albums for me." So Haoyang begins, one photograph at a time. He has never met most of the people in them, and the world they belonged to feels very far away. But every photograph, every letter, every old document points toward the story of one family. Tracing a family through old photographs · Sort the photographs: place more than 160 photographs into the right spots in the family album. · Identify the portraits: click on the people in the photographs to extract their portraits, and use the clues to identify them. · Follow the clues: read memoirs, notes, identity papers, old letters, and newspaper clippings for the details time has buried. · Complete the family tree: match the names you collect to the portraits, fill in the family tree, and untangle the relationships between generations. · Talk to the family: open your phone and ask relatives about the stories behind the photographs. · Look things up: browse Kiwi Wiki for the objects, places, and eras in the photographs—or put on a record and take your time. A century of memories, one ordinary family The story told by these old photographs runs from 1915 to 1985. A village in Hebei, an apprentice's workshop in Tianjin, the hide trade in Shanxi, an old house in Xi'an, a new life after reform and opening-up... The joys and sorrows of an ordinary Chinese family are scattered across photographs, documents, and the stories relatives tell. Across six summer days, six batches of photographs arrive. There are no countdowns and no fail states. You can spend a quiet summer afternoon looking at one photograph, getting to know one person. In the end In these old black-and-white photographs, the youth they have lost remains. And there, too, is the place we ourselves came from. Content note: the story deals with the death of a family member and twentieth-century Chinese history. There is no graphic violence. A note for English players This game features a great deal of Chinese culture and customs. Players outside the Chinese cultural sphere may find some references difficult to understand.
